tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of Native American Business Development appointed pursuant to section 4303(a)(2) of this title.

tree.heading: Eligible entity
tree.text: The term “eligible entity” means an Indian Tribe or Tribal organization, an Indian arts and crafts organization, as that term is defined in section 305a of this title, a Tribal enterprise, a Tribal marketing cooperative (as that term is defined by the Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of the Interior), or any other Indian-owned business.

tree.heading: Indian
tree.text: The term “Indian” has the meaning given that term in section 5304(d) of this title.

tree.heading: Indian goods and services
tree.text: The term “Indian goods and services” means—

children.text: Indian goods, within the meaning of section 305a of this title;
goods produced or originated by an eligible entity; and

children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “Indian lands” includes lands under the definition of—
the term “Indian country” under section 1151 of title 18; or

children.heading: Former Indian reservations in Oklahoma
children.text: For purposes of applying section 1452(d) of this title under subparagraph (A)(ii), the term “former Indian reservations in Oklahoma” shall be construed to include lands that are—
within the jurisdictional areas of an Oklahoma Indian Tribe (as determined by the Secretary of the Interior); and
recognized by the Secretary of the Interior as eligible for trust land status under part 151 of title 25, Code of Federal Regulations (as in effect on November 7, 2000).

tree.heading: Indian-owned business
tree.text: The term “Indian-owned business” means an entity organized for the conduct of trade or commerce with respect to which at least 50 percent of the property interests of the entity are owned by Indians or Indian Tribes (or a combination thereof).

tree.heading: Indian Tribe
tree.text: The term “Indian Tribe” has the meaning given the term “Indian tribe” in section 5304(e) of this title.

tree.heading: Office
tree.text: The term “Office” means the Office of Native American Business Development established by section 4303(a)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Commerce.

tree.heading: Tribal enterprise
tree.text: The term “Tribal enterprise” means a commercial activity or business managed or controlled by an Indian Tribe.

tree.heading: Tribal organization
tree.text: The term “Tribal organization” has the meaning given that term in section 5304(l) of this title.
